items.q: Do I send my passwords to CyberQUA?
items.a: No. The SDK hashes the password on-device with SHA-1 and only sends the first 5 characters. The comparison also happens on-device.

items.q: Do you store the links or code I send?
items.a: No. Usage logs only contain the time, endpoint, status code and latency. Links, emails, password hashes and code are never stored.
No. Only the URL itself and external reputation sources are analysed; no request is ever sent to the target page.

items.q: Can I use it from the browser?
items.a: Yes, with publishable (cq_pub_) keys and only from domains you allow. Secret keys only work server-side.

items.q: What happens when I run out of quota?
items.a: The API returns 429 quota_exceeded. Quotas reset at the start of each month (UTC).
